title: Devil's Diary
description: An evil entity wreaks havoc on a small-town high school and the surrounding community.

title: Embrace of the Vampire
description: A sheltered teen leaves an all-girls Catholic school for a new life at a co-ed university, where an ancient demon torments her with disturbing nightmares and threatens her soul.

title: My Life Is a Lifetime Movie
description:
S01 E01 — Lovely Little Liars
A high school history teacher is involved in a sex scandal with one of her students; a woman's whirlwind romance with a Cuban spy.

title: We Have Your Husband
description: After her husband Eduardo is kidnapped near their ranch in Mexico, Jayne has to raise enough money to ransom him back.

title: The Perfect Killer
description: Mila and her stepdaughter find out that the fatal shooting of her husband was linked to an AI voice scam. When Mila is later attacked by an unknown assailant, she soon starts to wonder if the killer is someone close to them.

title: Secrets to Kill For
description: Lifestyle blogger Shanice returns to her hometown when her childhood friend, June, goes missing. When June is found murdered, Shanice herself becomes a target as she starts to uncover dark secrets that suggest the killer is much closer to home.

title: Kidnapped by a Killer: The Heather Robinson Story
description: Fifteen-year-old Heather Robinson's world comes crashing down when the man she knew as her uncle, John Robinson, is arrested for the murders of multiple women in the Kansas City area, including her biological mother.

title: Beyond the Headlines: The Kamiyah Mobley Story With Robin Roberts
description: Kidnapped at birth in 1998 by a woman she grew up believing was her mother, Kamiyah Mobley sits down exclusively with award-winning journalist Robin Roberts for a revealing interview about life since her true identity was exposed.

title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E04 — Chris Watts
